units.source_text: 正要走出房门，他眼里闪现一件微微发白的东西，回头看去，原来是一个桐木造的三弦琴盒。

en.t: Just as he was about to leave the room, a faintly whitish object flashed into his sight; when he turned back to look, it was a paulownia shamisen case.

units.source_text: 看起来要比实际的三弦琴盒大而长，简直无法令人相信，她竟背着这个赴宴。

en.t: It looked larger and longer than an actual shamisen case, making it almost impossible to believe that she had carried it on her back to a banquet.

units.source_text: 这么想着的时候，被烟熏黑了的隔扇门开了。

en.t: As he was thinking this, the smoke-blackened sliding door opened.
